$comment: Hosts the deployed web app may contact, by network purpose (NetPurpose in web/src/security/net.ts, the only module that calls fetch). Each value is an array of entries: "self" for the app's own origin, or a bare origin such as "https://example.org". An empty array means the app contacts no fixed host for that purpose. Hosts the user enters (a provider endpoint, an MCP server, a sync relay) are not fixed and are not listed; net.ts still requires HTTPS or the loopback for them and shows each one in the transparency panel. Adding a host here is a reviewed change.

$purposes.app: The app's own files: the shell, its chunks, the manifest, the service worker and its precache.
$purposes.provider: The default API hosts of the model providers the app ships (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter). User-entered endpoints (local servers, OpenAI-compatible services, custom base URLs) are not listed.
$purposes.mcp: Placeholder: fixed MCP servers. User-added servers are not listed.
$purposes.tool: Hosts a tool reaches once the user approved the call (the built-in fetch_url): chosen by the conversation, never fixed, so none are listed.
$purposes.sync: The fixed API hosts of the sync destinations the app ships (GitHub). Carries the aparte/1 objects only: ciphertext, the format marker and the keyslots. User-entered stores (an S3 endpoint, a self-hosted relay) are not listed.
$purposes.download: Pinned, hash-checked downloads of in-browser model files and runtimes, made by the model workers only: Hugging Face model repositories read at a fixed commit (huggingface.co, which redirects the large files to its CDN hosts below, by region), and the compiled WebLLM model libraries at a fixed commit of mlc-ai/binary-mlc-llm-libs (raw.githubusercontent.com). Every file is checked against a SHA-256 shipped with the app; ONNX Runtime is self-hosted under the app's origin.
$purposes.catalog: Placeholder: the model catalog the app refreshes, if it is fetched rather than bundled.
